content: I umeqqran n imeɣnajen. Ak-d uzenzun x ifiřan. Axemmi n Dawud.
Řami dd-usin Izifiyyen, nnan as i Cawul: “Ma war issnuffar Dawud ixef nnes ɣarneɣ?”
Senjem ayi, a AREBBI, s Yisem nnec, aɣ ayi tasɣart s tzemmar nnec ijehden.
A AREBBI, seř i tẓaǧit inu, sḥess i wawařen n uqemmum inu.
Maɣar ibarraniyyen kkaren akidi, ayt n bu-řexcunet arezzun ad ayi nɣen. War tteggen ca AREBBI zzat i tiṭṭawin nsen. Silah.
Xzar, AREBBI d amɛawen inu. Sidi inu aqa-t jar yinni d ayi isennden.
Netta ad ixeǧeṣ řɣar i yinni d ayi iḥeṣṣaren. Qḍa xasen di řaman nnec.
S řxaḍar ad ac dd-awyeɣ tiɣarṣa, ad qadiɣ Isem nnec, a SIDI, maɣar Netta d aṣebḥan,
maɣar Netta ifekk ayi zi marra řeḥṣaret, uca yarra ayi-dd ad xezzareɣ x řɛedyan inu swadday.

footnotes.text: arezzun ad ayi nɣen- s Tɛibranit ‘arezzun ad nɣen řeɛmar inu’.
